cli.agents_help.create_name: Name of the agent to create
cli.agents_help.delete: Delete an agent (local by name or Radient by ID)
cli.agents_help.delete_name: Name of the agent to delete locally
cli.agents_help.delete_id: ID of the agent to delete from Radient
cli.agents_help.delete_org: Delete an agent from this organization's workspace instead of the public hub (Agent Hub org sharing; requires `lop login radient`)
cli.agents_help.push: Push (upload) an agent to Radient; `--org` and `--hub-id` push through the preview/confirm flow (exit codes: 0 published, 1 error, 2 preview-only with changes pending, 3 declined, 130 cancelled)
cli.agents_help.push_name: Name of the agent to push to Radient
cli.agents_help.push_id: ID of the agent to push to Radient (explicit overwrite)
cli.agents_help.push_org: Publish into this organization's workspace instead of the public hub (Agent Hub org sharing; requires `lop login radient`)
cli.agents_help.push_hub_id: Republish (overwrite) this hub listing from the local agent (checks for personal references first); needs --name (--id is a local id)
cli.agents_help.pull_id: ID of the agent to pull from Radient
cli.agents_help.pull_org: Pull from this organization's workspace instead of the public hub (Agent Hub org sharing; requires `lop login radient`)
cli.agents_help.sync: Update installed starters and hub-pulled agents to their latest text
cli.agents_help.sync_name: Sync only the installed profile with this name
cli.agents_help.sync_all: Sync every installed starter and hub-pulled agent (default when --name is absent)
